description: This file defines a public enumeration 'LocalNetworkURLSupport' with a static method 'isLocalNetworkHTTPURL' that checks if a given URL is a local network HTTP or HTTPS URL, utilizing the 'LoopbackHost' class or struct for host validation.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkHTTPURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL has the scheme 'http' or 'https' and if its host is a local network host.
